roles.Operator: The integration operator working the case
roles.Approver: The person who approves an exact resend
roles.Integration team: Owns the interfaces, mappings and policies
roles.Downstream system team: Owns the demo bed-management system (the downstream system)
roles.PAS team: Owns the patient administration system and its patient records: merges, and the source of the events

reasons.title: The patient doesn't match the encounter
reasons.prerequisite: One patient identity for the encounter: the message's PID-3 and the downstream system's record agree (ELS-3.1)
reasons.next_action: Escalate the identity conflict to the integration team. Nothing is sent.
reasons.reevaluate_when: A corrected message or a confirmed identity arrives
reasons.text: The message names a different patient or assigning authority from the one the downstream system holds for this encounter. An identity conflict is never a movement to apply.

reasons.title: The downstream system has never seen this encounter
reasons.prerequisite: An applied admission for the encounter (WIC-4)
reasons.next_action: Check whether the admission failed too and recover it first; otherwise escalate.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The admission is applied or found
reasons.text: The downstream system has no admission for this visit number, so a transfer, discharge or update can't apply.

reasons.title: The downstream system's record couldn't be read
reasons.prerequisite: A successful read of the encounter and its history (WIC-5.1)
reasons.next_action: Collect the evidence again. If the downstream system stays unreadable, contact the downstream system team.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The downstream system answers reads again
reasons.text: Without the downstream system's current state and history, supersession and transitions can't be judged, so nothing is eligible.

reasons.title: The message couldn't be mapped to an operation
reasons.prerequisite: A message the inbound profile can map (WIC-6)
reasons.next_action: Escalate to the integration team with the message.
reasons.reevaluate_when: A corrected message arrives or the mapping is fixed
reasons.text: Fields the operation needs, such as the visit number, the event time or the patient identifier, are missing or malformed.

reasons.title: The message can't become a downstream operation
reasons.prerequisite: A message the inbound profile maps to an operation (WIC-6)
reasons.next_action: Escalate to the integration team with the message: correct it at the source and send it again.
reasons.reevaluate_when: A corrected message arrives or the mapping is fixed
reasons.text: The feed couldn't map the message to an operation: a field the operation needs is missing or malformed, or the profile maps no operation for its event. Shutter opened a case so the failure isn't lost, but nothing can be resent from it.

reasons.title: The proposal named an outcome the playbooks don't have
reasons.prerequisite: One of resend, reconcile, superseded, more evidence or escalate (RP-1)
reasons.next_action: Run the investigation again; if it repeats, escalate.
reasons.text: Only the five playbook outcomes can be acted on.

reasons.title: The plan is for a different operation
reasons.prerequisite: The plan's operation key is the failed movement's key (WIC-2.2)
reasons.next_action: Discard the plan and investigate again.
reasons.reevaluate_when: A new plan for the failed operation exists
reasons.text: A recovery may only resend the same business operation, never a different one.

reasons.title: The payload differs from the original
reasons.prerequisite: The same canonical payload and digest as the failed movement (WIC-2.4)
reasons.next_action: Escalate: content that changed under the same key needs the integration team (RP-2.5).
reasons.text: A resend must carry exactly the original movement: changed content isn't a recovery. A further failure for the same operation with different content blocks the open case for the same reason.

reasons.title: A later event made this movement obsolete
reasons.prerequisite: No later location event that supersedes this one: a transfer or discharge the downstream system applied, a later transfer the PAS sent whose delivery failed too, or a later cancel, merge or admission the downstream system applied (ELS-2.1, ELS-2.3)
reasons.next_action: Close the case as superseded, recording the superseding event. Nothing is sent.
reasons.reevaluate_when: Only if the later event is itself reversed
reasons.text: The encounter has a later transfer or discharge with a plausible event time: one the downstream system applied, a later transfer the PAS sent whose delivery failed too, which its own case recovers, or a later cancel, merge or admission the downstream system applied. Resending would move the patient's record backwards.

reasons.title: The claimed later event is not in the evidence
reasons.prerequisite: A later transfer or discharge in the snapshot: applied, or a later transfer whose delivery failed too (ELS-2.1)
reasons.next_action: Check the receiver's history for the encounter. If a later event exists, collect evidence again; otherwise the operation may still be due, so re-plan.
reasons.text: The plan closes the case as superseded, but the snapshot holds no later transfer or discharge for the encounter. A supersession must be shown by the evidence, not asserted.

reasons.title: The downstream system wouldn't allow this movement now
reasons.prerequisite: A transition the downstream system allows from the encounter's state (WIC-4)
reasons.next_action: Check for supersession, such as a discharge, and close; otherwise escalate.
reasons.text: For example, a transfer after a discharge: the downstream system refuses it, and resending can't help.

reasons.title: The downstream system already committed this movement
reasons.prerequisite: No receipt for the operation key, before any resend (RP-2.1)
reasons.next_action: Reconcile: record the receipt and verify the history. Never resend.
reasons.text: A receipt with the same payload exists, so the movement happened even though the sender saw an error.

reasons.title: No receipt for this operation
reasons.prerequisite: A receipt for the operation key, to reconcile (RP-2.2)
reasons.next_action: Investigate again: the movement wasn't committed, so reconciling doesn't apply.
reasons.reevaluate_when: A receipt appears or an investigation proposes another outcome
reasons.text: Reconciling needs proof that the downstream system committed the movement; there is none.

reasons.title: The receipt lookup didn't answer
reasons.prerequisite: An answer from the receipt lookup (WIC-5.2)
reasons.next_action: Collect the evidence again later. The outcome stays unknown until the lookup answers.
reasons.text: No answer isn't the same as no receipt. Until the lookup answers, nothing may be resent (RP-3.1).

reasons.title: Nobody has approved this plan yet
reasons.prerequisite: An approval of exactly this plan (RP-2.1, RP-3.4)
reasons.next_action: Send the plan to an approver.
reasons.text: A resend needs a person's approval of the exact request.

reasons.title: The approval was revoked
reasons.prerequisite: A current approval
reasons.next_action: Review the plan again and ask for a new approval if it still holds.
reasons.text: The approver withdrew the approval before dispatch.

reasons.title: The approval expired
reasons.prerequisite: An approval within its expiry
reasons.next_action: Collect fresh evidence and ask for a new approval.
reasons.text: Approvals are time-limited, because the downstream system's state can change.

reasons.title: The plan changed after approval
reasons.prerequisite: An approval of this plan version
reasons.next_action: Ask for approval of the new plan.
reasons.text: An approval covers one exact plan; any change needs a new one (RP-3.4).

reasons.title: The evidence changed after approval
reasons.prerequisite: An approval bound to the current evidence
reasons.next_action: Review the new evidence, and approve again if the plan still holds.
reasons.text: New evidence arrived after the approval, so the approver hasn't seen what the plan now rests on.

reasons.title: The policy changed after approval
reasons.prerequisite: An approval under the current policy version
reasons.next_action: Run the checks again under the new policy, and approve again.
reasons.text: The rules the approval relied on have a new version.

reasons.title: The catalogue changed after approval
reasons.prerequisite: An approval given under the catalogue version the plan was matched against
reasons.next_action: Investigate again under the current catalogue, and approve again if the plan still holds.
reasons.text: An entry of the scenario catalogue has a new version since the approval, so the match the plan rests on may no longer hold.

reasons.title: The site profile changed after approval
reasons.prerequisite: An approval given under the current site profile version
reasons.next_action: Review the plan under the new profile, and approve again if it still applies.
reasons.text: The site's profile (its policies, its tiers or its receiver description) has a new version since the approval, so who decides and what is allowed may have changed.

reasons.title: The downstream system's state changed after approval
reasons.prerequisite: The downstream system's version and epoch the approval was bound to
reasons.next_action: Collect fresh evidence: a later event may have superseded the movement.
reasons.text: Something was applied to the encounter after the approval, or the downstream system was reset, so the approved request may no longer be right.

reasons.title: The downstream system was reset after approval
reasons.prerequisite: The downstream system's epoch the approval was bound to
reasons.next_action: Collect fresh evidence: after a reset the downstream system's records start again, and versions from before it don't compare.
reasons.text: The downstream system's epoch changed after the approval, so the version the approver saw belongs to records that no longer exist (WIC-1.4).

reasons.title: The approval record isn't an approval
reasons.prerequisite: An approval with the decision approved
reasons.next_action: Ask an approver to decide on the current plan.
reasons.text: The record the dispatch found holds another decision, so it authorises nothing.

reasons.title: The resend has no expected version
reasons.prerequisite: expected_version set to the encounter's current version (WIC-2.3)
reasons.next_action: Rebuild the plan from fresh evidence.
reasons.text: A resend must be conditional, so that the downstream system refuses it if anything changed in between.

reasons.title: The downstream system's state changed before dispatch
reasons.prerequisite: The downstream system's version still matches the plan at dispatch
reasons.next_action: Collect fresh evidence and investigate again.
reasons.text: The check before dispatch found a newer version, so the conditional write would be refused anyway.

reasons.title: The evidence is too old
reasons.prerequisite: Evidence within its freshness limit
reasons.next_action: Collect the evidence again.
reasons.text: Observations of the current state age quickly; decisions use a fresh read.

reasons.title: The downstream system can't take a conditional write now
reasons.prerequisite: Conditional writes shown in the downstream system's capability profile
reasons.next_action: Escalate for manual handling, or wait until the capability is back. Reconcile and superseded remain possible.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The downstream system's capability profile changes
reasons.text: Without conditional writes, nothing makes sure the resend lands on the state the approver saw, so resending isn't offered.

reasons.title: The downstream system's capability profile couldn't be read
reasons.prerequisite: An answer from the downstream system's capability profile (WIC-7)
reasons.next_action: Collect the evidence again later. Nothing is assumed about the downstream system's guarantees meanwhile.
reasons.text: Without the profile it is unknown whether the downstream system still honours conditional writes and receipts, so no write is dispatched (WIC-7.2).

reasons.title: The rehearsal says the resend wouldn't apply
reasons.prerequisite: A dry run of the exact request that would apply (WIC-2.5)
reasons.next_action: Escalate with the rehearsal's reason (RP-2.5).
reasons.text: The downstream system's dry run of the exact request reported a refusal.

reasons.title: The approver rejected the plan
reasons.prerequisite: An approval
reasons.next_action: Read the approver's reason, then investigate again or escalate.
reasons.reevaluate_when: A new plan or new evidence exists
reasons.text: A person declined the request.

reasons.title: The downstream system refused the resend
reasons.prerequisite: The downstream system accepting the conditional write
reasons.next_action: Read the downstream system's answer: for a version conflict, collect fresh evidence; for anything else, escalate.
reasons.text: The conditional write was refused, so nothing changed.

reasons.title: Handed to a person
reasons.prerequisite: A decision only a person can make
reasons.next_action: Read the findings and the gate's notes, then decide how to recover the message by hand.
reasons.text: The investigation asked for a person: the evidence doesn't settle what should happen, or nothing Shutter may do would settle it.

reasons.title: Stopped before any write
reasons.prerequisite: What the case's last events name
reasons.next_action: Read the case's last events for the reason, then investigate again or escalate.
reasons.text: The case stopped without a gate check to name the reason; its timeline says why.

reasons.title: The plan names an unknown scenario
reasons.prerequisite: A catalogue entry that exists at the plan's catalogue version
reasons.next_action: Investigate again so the plan names an entry from the current catalogue, or escalate.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The catalogue changes or the case is investigated again
reasons.text: The plan cites a catalogue entry the catalogue doesn't have, so the gate can't check its pattern or its outcomes.

reasons.title: The case doesn't fit the scenario the plan names
reasons.prerequisite: A plan whose catalogue entry matches the evidence
reasons.next_action: Read the observed conditions on the case; investigate again or escalate.
reasons.text: The entry the plan names doesn't match the evidence snapshot: at least one of its conditions has another value here.

reasons.title: This site doesn't allow the chosen outcome
reasons.prerequisite: An outcome the site profile allows
reasons.next_action: Choose the entry's preferred outcome, or ask the integration team to change the site profile.
reasons.text: The plan chose an alternative outcome whose condition doesn't hold for this site, for example history correction where the site keeps what is current.

reasons.title: The plan doesn't do what its catalogue outcome says
reasons.prerequisite: A disposition that is what the outcome the plan chose from its catalogue entry calls for
reasons.next_action: Investigate again so the plan's disposition follows the entry's outcome, or escalate.
reasons.text: The plan names a catalogue outcome but proposes another disposition, for example a resend where the outcome calls for no write.

reasons.title: No known scenario fits
reasons.prerequisite: A catalogue entry for this pattern
reasons.next_action: Read the board's analysis and resolve the case by hand; flag it as a candidate catalogue entry.
reasons.reevaluate_when: A reviewer adds an entry for the pattern
reasons.text: No entry in the scenario catalogue matches this case's evidence. The board analysed it, but a new pattern is settled by a person, and may become a new entry.

reasons.title: This site's policy needs an approval
reasons.prerequisite: A person's approval, as the site profile requires
reasons.next_action: Approve or reject the plan in its Workflow task.
reasons.text: An automatic release was attempted where the site profile requires a person's approval for this tier and kind of chain.

reasons.title: The policy's approval needs a plan from the policy path
reasons.prerequisite: A plan from the policy path for the entry the automatic release names
reasons.next_action: Investigate again so the plan comes from the policy path for its entry, or have a person approve it.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The case is investigated again or a person approves the plan
reasons.text: An approval by site policy stands only for a plan the policy path produced for its catalogue entry. This plan came from elsewhere, so the automatic release does not cover it.

reasons.title: The catalogue matcher failed
reasons.prerequisite: A matcher result for the case's conditions
reasons.next_action: Investigate again. If the error repeats, the integration team checks the catalogue and the matcher.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The case is investigated again or the catalogue is corrected
reasons.text: The matcher raised an error instead of a result. That is not the same as no matching entry: the pattern may well be known, so the gate blocks rather than treating the case as new.

reasons.title: The receiver keeps no receipts
reasons.prerequisite: For a reconcile: the operation in the receiver's history, since the receiver's description has no receipt endpoint (6.4)
reasons.next_action: Check the receiver's own records for the operation. If it was applied, a person confirms and the case closes; if it was not, the plan should resend under the capability check, not reconcile.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The receiver's history shows the operation, or the plan takes another outcome
reasons.text: This receiver publishes no receipts, so whether the operation was applied can only be read from its history. A reconcile is right when the history shows the operation; this history does not, so there is nothing to reconcile against.

reasons.title: The event's time, or a later event's, doesn't fit the encounter
reasons.prerequisite: An event time that fits the encounter: after its admission, not in the future, close to the time the PAS recorded it, and not inside a clock change when it carries no offset; and later events it is ordered against timed no more than five minutes after they were sent, applied or seen
reasons.next_action: Confirm the event's real time, or the later event's, with the source system: for a time far before it was recorded, whether it was entered retrospectively; for one in the future or before the admission, whether a clock or the typed time is wrong; for one within an hour of a clock change, which side of the change it was. Then reinvestigate the case or correct the history.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The source system confirms or corrects the time
reasons.text: Shutter orders and supersedes movements by their event time. A time before the admission, in the future, far from when the PAS recorded the event, or in the hour of a clock change can't be ordered safely, nor can a later event timed well after it was sent, applied or seen when that event would decide whether this one was overtaken. Such a time is not simply bad data: one more than a day before the PAS recorded it is usually a retrospective entry (paper notes typed in later), one in the future or before the admission usually a clock fault or a mistyped time, and a local time without an offset within an hour of a clock change may be one that night holds twice (or never), so only the source can say when it was. The messages can't tell these apart, so nothing is written and a person decides.

reasons.title: A merge is never sent by Shutter
reasons.prerequisite: The site profile says merges: allowed and the receiver's entry says merges: true (CONTRACTS 6.4)
reasons.next_action: Hand the merge to the PAS team named for the sending application; mark the case handled when it confirms what it did.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The PAS team confirms the merge or declines it
reasons.text: An ADT^A40 merge changes which record a patient's history belongs to. Shutter withholds it under the site's policy, or because the receiver takes no merges, and sends nothing.

reasons.title: The receiver cannot reverse the event
reasons.prerequisite: A receiver whose entry says cancels: true
reasons.next_action: Correct the receiver by hand, then mark the case handled on the case page.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The receiver gains a reversal, or the team confirms the correction
reasons.text: The message cancels an earlier movement, and the receiver's entry says it takes no cancels. Shutter withholds the cancel and sends nothing; a person corrects the receiver.

reasons.title: The receiver's category is not modelled yet
reasons.prerequisite: A receiver whose site profile category is current_state or history_of_record (the ADT catalogue covers movements, not orders and results)
reasons.next_action: Handle the failure in the receiving system by hand, then mark the case handled on the case page. Nothing is sent.
reasons.reevaluate_when: Shutter gains a catalogue for order communications and results, or the receiver's category changes
reasons.text: The receiver keeps orders and results (category orders_results), which Shutter's catalogue does not model yet. Shutter sends it nothing and does not judge the failure; a person handles it in the receiving system.

reasons.title: The operation names no encounter
reasons.prerequisite: An encounter whose state and version the receiver can show
reasons.next_action: A person decides: the message is patient-level (a merge with no visit number).
reasons.reevaluate_when: A message that names the encounter arrives, or a person decides
reasons.text: Shutter writes only to an encounter whose state and version it can read and compare. A patient-level message names none, so there is nothing to check a write against.

reasons.title: The incident's approval covered another entry or outcome for this item
reasons.prerequisite: The released item's plan and fresh evidence follow the catalogue entry and outcome the incident's approval bound for it
reasons.next_action: A person reviews the item on its fresh evidence: approve its own plan, or reinvestigate.
reasons.reevaluate_when: A person approves the item's own plan
reasons.text: The incident's approval named this operation as one catalogue entry and outcome, and its plan or its fresh evidence now reads another. The release does not cover it, so nothing is sent and the chain stops here.

reasons.title: The incident's plan changed after its approval
reasons.prerequisite: An incident plan whose digest is the one the approval bound
reasons.next_action: Review the incident's plan as it is now, and approve it again if it still holds.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The incident's current plan is approved
reasons.text: The approval the released item stands on named an incident plan digest that is no longer the incident's, or the case no longer belongs to the incident. An approval covers one exact plan (RP-3.4).

reasons.title: The downstream system offers no dry run
reasons.prerequisite: dry_run shown in the downstream system's capability profile (WIC-2.5)
reasons.next_action: Escalate for manual handling. Reconcile and superseded remain possible; a resend is not offered to a receiver that cannot rehearse it.
reasons.text: Without a dry run nothing shows that the exact request would apply before it is written, so resending is not offered.

reasons.title: The exact request was never rehearsed
reasons.prerequisite: A dry run of this plan, bound to its approval (WIC-2.5)
reasons.next_action: Investigate again: the case rehearses the plan before any approval.
reasons.text: The approval carries no dry run of this plan, so the write would be blind.

reasons.title: The rehearsal of this plan reported a refusal
reasons.prerequisite: A dry run of the exact request that would apply (WIC-2.5)
reasons.next_action: Escalate with the rehearsal's reason (RP-2.5).
reasons.text: The dry run bound to the approval said the request would not apply; nothing is dispatched on it.

reasons.title: The rehearsal was checked against another version
reasons.prerequisite: A dry run at the version and epoch the write is conditional on, with the same payload
reasons.next_action: Collect fresh evidence and investigate again; the case rehearses the new plan.
reasons.text: The dry run was checked against a different receiver version, epoch or payload from the write's, so it proves nothing about this write.

reasons.title: The resend was not committed
reasons.prerequisite: A receipt for the operation key, or the operation in the downstream system's history, once the receiver has had its settle window after a write whose answer was lost
reasons.next_action: Check the receiver's history and receipts for the operation key; reinvestigate the case when the receiver's state is known. Never resend blind.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The receiver's state for the encounter is known, and a person has decided whether the movement is still due
reasons.text: The write's answer was lost. After the settle window the receiver holds no receipt for the operation and its history does not show it, and the encounter is still at the version the write was conditional on (or moved past it by something else, so the conditional write can no longer apply): nothing was applied. The approval authorised one write and it is spent; a reinvestigation makes a new plan on fresh evidence.

reasons.title: The resend's outcome is unknown
reasons.prerequisite: A receipt, the history or the settle window settling what the receiver did with a write whose answer was lost
reasons.next_action: Check the receiver's history and receipts for the operation key; reinvestigate the case when the receiver's state is known. Never resend blind.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The receiver can be read again, or its team confirms what it applied
reasons.text: The write's answer was lost, and the reads that followed could not settle whether the receiver applied it: a lookup failed, the receiver no longer knows the encounter, or the budget of reads ran out. Nothing is established either way, so nothing is resent until a person has checked at the receiver.

reasons.title: Waiting for the bed's occupant to leave
reasons.prerequisite: The destination bed is free: the occupant's movement out has been applied (E16)
reasons.next_action: Nothing to do yet. The case is checked again when the case about the occupant's movement closes; recover that case first if it needs a person.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The occupant's case resolves, or their movement out is applied
reasons.text: The receiver refused this movement because another patient's encounter holds the bed, and that patient's movement out is still being recovered in another case. Resending now would be refused again, so this case waits for that one.

reasons.title: The bed's occupant is not leaving after all
reasons.prerequisite: The case about the occupant's movement out resolves, so the bed frees (E16)
reasons.next_action: Escalate to the bed manager with the conflict: the bed, the occupant's encounter, the refused movement. Nothing is sent.
reasons.reevaluate_when: A person frees or reallocates the bed, or the occupant's case is resolved by hand
reasons.text: The case about the occupant's movement out of the bed ended escalated, failed or abandoned, so the bed will not free itself. A person must decide where each patient is.

reasons.title: Two patients for one bed
reasons.prerequisite: The destination bed is free, or a movement out of it is known for its occupant (E16, E17)
reasons.next_action: Escalate to the bed manager with the conflict laid out. Nothing is sent: a resend would be refused again or double-book the bed.
reasons.reevaluate_when: A person frees or reallocates the bed
reasons.text: The receiver holds another patient's encounter in the destination bed and nothing says they are leaving, or the occupant could not be read. That is a clash on the ward, not a delivery fault.

reasons.title: The bed's occupant has left
reasons.prerequisite: The occupant's movement out of the bed is applied at the receiver (E16)
reasons.next_action: None: a pass. The resend goes ahead under the tier's approval policy, conditional on this encounter's version.
reasons.text: The patient who held the destination bed has moved out of it at the receiver, so the refused movement can be sent again. The receiver refuses it again if the bed is held after all.

reasons.title: A newer message for this patient is on its way
reasons.prerequisite: No message for the encounter reached Shutter after the case's own and is still waiting to be delivered to this receiver
reasons.next_action: Nothing to do yet. The case waits for that message; when it is delivered, the case is checked again on fresh evidence, and a newer movement usually means nothing needs resending.
reasons.reevaluate_when: The newer message is delivered to the receiver, or its delivery fails and opens a case of its own
reasons.text: While Shutter was about to resend this movement, a newer message for the same patient arrived from the source system and has not yet reached the receiver. Resending first would be pointless at best, and wrong behind a cancellation or a merge, so the resend waits for the newer message.
